scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && concurrently -n shared,server,client -c yellow,blue,green "tsc -p shared --watch" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.test: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm test -w shared && npm test -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json
scripts.test:integration: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && tsx scripts/test-integration.ts
scripts.lint: eslint shared server client scripts eslint.config.ts --max-warnings 0
scripts.check: npm run check:source && npm run lint && npm run typecheck
